subject: maths
question: A train travels for 2 hours at a speed of 6 m/sec. What is the distance covered by the train in the mentioned duration of time?
solution:
GIVEN:

Speed = 6 m/sec

time = 2 hours

FORMULA USED:

Speed = distance/time

⇒ distance = speed × time

CALCULATION:

Speed of the car = 6 m/sec

Time = 2 hour = 2 × 60 × 60 = 7200 sec

Distance travelled = 6 × 7200 = 43200 m = 43.2 km
